facts.fact_text: The applicant is the chairman of a regional branch of the Republic Party («Հանրապետություն» կուսակցություն).
Following the first and second rounds of the 2003 Armenian presidential election, a series of protest rallies were organised in Yerevan by the opposition parties.
On 20 February 2003 the applicant participated in a demonstration held in Yerevan.
The demonstration held in Yerevan on 20 February 2003 was apparently followed by a march.
On 26 February 2003 the applicant and two other members of the Republic Party set off by car from Ashnak village to Yerevan.
On 14 May 2003 the applicant participated in a demonstration held in Yerevan.
The applicant alleged that on the road to Yerevan their car was stopped by several individuals in civilian clothes.
The applicant alleged that the individuals who stopped their car introduced themselves as officers of the Aragatsotn Regional Police Department.
The applicant and his colleagues were taken to the Aragatsotn Regional Police Department.
From the Aragatsotn Regional Police Department, the applicant was transferred to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan.
At the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, an administrative case was initiated against the applicant on account of his participation in the demonstration of 20 February 2003.

After a brief hearing, Judge A. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to ten days of administrative detention.
Judge A. found that on 20 February 2003 the applicant participated in an unauthorised march, thus violating the prescribed rules for organising and holding street marches and demonstrations.
On 21 May 2003 the applicant was taken to a police station.
On 21 May 2003 the applicant was transported from a police station to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan.

At the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, an administrative fine of 1,000 Armenian drams (AMD) was imposed on the applicant for having organised the participation of a group of people from his region in an unauthorised demonstration on 14 May 2003.

The decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan stated that it was not subject to appeal.
The decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan stated that it could be protested against only by the prosecutor.
The applicant's lawyer argued, relying on various domestic provisions, that he was entitled to lodge an appeal against the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan.
The applicant's lawyer submitted that the interference with the applicant's right to freedom of peaceful assembly was in violation of the Constitution of Armenia and was not prescribed by law.

The applicant's lawyer submitted that the penalty imposed on the applicant was excessive.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found, having familiarised himself with the applicant's appeal and the materials concerning the administrative offence, that the penalty imposed on the applicant must be changed.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal changed the penalty imposed on the applicant to an administrative fine of 1,000 Armenian drams (AMD), approximately 1.5 euros (EUR) at the material time.
On 2 March 2003 the applicant was released from detention after having served approximately four days of his ten-day sentence.
